validation.evidence: 14 tests passed with 0 failures, covering conversation-only represented Person interests and exact-plus-fallback classification for partial Role, Message and GroupMembership notifications.
57 tests passed with 0 failures, including isolated Message-only root entry and reply-derived convergence, conversation-only Person isolation, and all prior dashboard binding behavior.
All Elixir source and test files are formatted.

notes: Conversation rows now register deduplicated exact Person interests for sender, originator, latest replier and displayed participants, including identities absent from dashboard member/candidate collections. Partial Role and Message envelopes retain exact keys while adding global family fallbacks when club scope is missing; GroupMembership always retains an available Person key and adds club/global participation fallback whenever club, group or person scope is incomplete. The root-entry proof creates authoritative conversation state before mount, removes and restores only the committed read rows, then delivers only the Message projector notification so ConversationGroupAccess cannot supply the refresh. Because complete GroupMembership invalidations now intentionally include an exact affected-Person key, route isolation is proven with an unrepresented old-group person while the selected-group notification remains exact. Initial TDD runs failed on the five missing query/source behaviors and then exposed two LiveView fixture issues (authoritative conversation audience and newly relevant represented candidates); both were repaired. An initial formatting invocation used web-prefixed paths unsupported by the root wrapper; the corrected formatter and final format check passed. No conversation-detail, package, full-adapter, acceptance-feature, domain/projector, delivery-dashboard or staff-stream work was introduced.
